meta.name: add-atomic-chat-tool
meta.description: Add Atomic Chat MCP server so the container agent can call local models served by the Atomic Chat desktop app via its OpenAI-compatible API.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让容器 agent 调用本地 AI 模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在容器中通过 OpenAI 兼容接口调用本地模型。
copy.tagline_en: Enable container agent to call local AI models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to call local models from a container via OpenAI-compatible API.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以通过 MCP 工具调用本地 Atomic Chat 桌面应用中的模型。它会列出可用模型，并向指定模型发送提示词获取回复。
howto.when: 当用户要求 Claude 使用本地模型执行任务（如问答、生成文本）时触发。需要 Atomic Chat 桌面应用已安装并运行，且本地 API 服务器已启用。

say.text: 用 atomic chat 列出可用模型。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can call local models served by the Atomic Chat desktop app via MCP tools. It lists available models and sends prompts to a specified model to get responses.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks Claude to perform a task using a local model (e.g., Q&A, text generation). Requires Atomic Chat desktop app installed and running with its local API server enabled.

say_en.text: Use atomic chat to list available models.
say_en.note: Claude will call the atomic_chat_list_models tool.

say_en.text: Use atomic chat's llama3.2-3b-instruct model to tell me the capital of France.
say_en.note: Claude will list models first, then call atomic_chat_generate to get a response.
